title.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系とSchur前処理
title.en: Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning

assumptions.ja: 速度12/24、圧力5/11の代数的混合Poisson/Stokes型ブロック。元の真の残差1e-9を共通基準にします。
assumptions.en: Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
algorithm.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.

validation.ja: LAPACK全系解、理想Schurの3点スペクトル、CGの明示的負曲率対照。
validation.en: Global LAPACK solutions, the analytic ideal-Schur spectrum and an explicit negative-curvature control for CG.

limits.ja: 理想Schurは教育用の稠密制御であり、実Stokes PDEやスケーラブルな近似前処理の完成ではありません。
limits.en: A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner.

review_level.ja: 入力・16独立参照・195科学判定は旧版から不変。R4科学実行の実際の成否はresult.json/verification.jsonへ記録し、旧失敗と別に保持します。
review_level.en: The fixed inputs, 16 independent reference checks and 195 scientific gates are unchanged. R4 passed the primary validation; actual package checks are recorded in result.json and verification.json. Earlier failed attempts remain separate.

title.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov
title.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products

summary.ja: 非線形Jacobianを組み立てずにBratuの上下枝を3種類のJvで解き、forcingと実際の残差・評価回数を保存します。
summary.en: Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts.

assumptions.ja: 同じ無次元1次元Dirichlet問題でλ=3、内点63/127、初期値0または4sin(πx)。3Jv×2格子×2枝の12解法と固定η=1e-8の解析Jv対照1本。GMRES restart24/max96、Newton最大24、残差許容1e-9です。
assumptions.en: The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
algorithm.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの129固定判定が合格。非零Jvの解析検算、離散残差、独立解析上下枝、3modeの一致、forcing、評価回数、Krylov記憶幅、Armijoと固定η対照を確認。解析forcing検算は別計数で、FD/ADの反復制御には使いません。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared27 pytest tests and this case’s129 fixed gates: nonzero analytic Jv qualification, discrete residuals, independent analytic branches, mode agreement, forcing, evaluation ledgers, Krylov storage, Armijo and the constant-eta control. Analytic forcing validation is counted separately and does not steer FD/AD iterations.

limits.ja: 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
limits.en: An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.
